symptom: /admin entry point could fall through to /app
root_cause: console entry point checked only legacy user.role and omitted persisted platform permission
fix: use admin.access platform.dashboard.read and canonical /admin/ route
prevention_rule: admin navigation visibility must use canonical permission resolver

symptom: runtime locale default diverged from configured pt-BR
fix: cookie-first SSR resolution with normalized supported locales
prevention_rule: validate SSR locale and html lang together

symptom: Hermes returned IN_PROGRESS despite local pending criteria and no blocker
root_cause: completion tests covered only static envelopes; no runtime task continuation runner was connected
fix: add hermes-autonomous-runner with explicit next/fix actions and terminal stop invariant
prevention_rule: IN_PROGRESS with pending criteria and null blocker must create a follow-up task

symptom: PARTIAL/CHECKPOINT result reached user despite local pending criteria and no blocker
root_cause: runner lacked canonical terminal-output guard and treated iteration exhaustion as a user-facing result
fix: add canReturnToUser/guardTerminalOutput, suppress non-terminal outputs, auto-resume checkpoints, and use non-terminal local continuation stop reason

symptom: A product workstream could return directly without the autonomous runner
root_cause: No public entrypoint enforced the terminal gate
fix: Add scripts/hermes-run.mjs and package script hermes:run; all normal workstreams route through runHermesWorkstream
prevention_rule: V3 workstreams must use the public autonomous entrypoint

symptom: Wrapper emitted a non-terminal progress summary after CLI terminal boundary
root_cause: External caller lacked a terminal-state assertion
fix: Add emitPublicResponse external boundary; suppress non-terminal candidates and route CREATE_NEXT_TASK
prevention_rule: Only HermesPublicTerminalOutput may emit user-facing workstream output

symptom: Public runner executed hermes-v3-runtime-fixture instead of requested persisted workstream
root_cause: CLI entrypoint supplied an implicit fixture when HERMES_WORKSTREAM was set or absent
fix: Add loadPersistedWorkstream and require explicit persisted workstream resolution; no fixture fallback
prevention_rule: No production fixture fallback; acceptance_loaded and identity are mandatory
